def: Young cabbage, used as "greens"; esp. a kind cultivated forthat purpose; colewort. [Colloq. Souther U. S.]
A vessel used on the Malabar coast, having two or three masts.
Bringing to a close; decisive; conclusive. [Obs.]Arguments highly consequential and concludent to my purpose. Sir M.Hale.
Land which borders on the sea; the seashore. Shak.You are near the sea marge of a land teeming with life. J. Burroughs.
Of or pertaining to the perichondrium; situated aroundcartilage.
Dried dung of cattle used as fuel. [Prov. Eng.] Waterland.
Perished; decayed. [Obs.]I deem thy brain emperished be. Spenser.
